description: Defines the NameDeprecation class in the Twig templating system, representing deprecation details for nodes or node attributes.

classes.name: NameDeprecation
classes.description: Class representing deprecation information for named nodes or attributes in Twig, including package, version, and new name details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing deprecation details with optional package, version, and new name.

methods.name: getPackage
methods.description: Returns the name of the package where deprecation occurred.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version when the deprecation was introduced.

methods.name: getNewName
methods.description: Returns the new name suggested or required after deprecation.
